title: A Candle Beyond the Spaceship Glass

segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Sit with the flame near eye level. Keep blinking naturally and stop if the eyes become painful, dizzy, excessively watery, or persistently uncomfortable.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [quiet spacecraft ventilation hum] Imagine the flame as a tiny sun beyond the glass of a quiet spacecraft.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Rest the gaze near the wick. Let the surrounding room become deep space without forcing it away.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice flicker, colour, brightness, and the small dark centre. Gentle attention is enough.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Blink and return, as though the navigation window refreshes itself.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Close your eyes. Notice whether the tiny sun remains as an after-image behind the lids.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Watch it drift, pulse, reverse colour, or fade through the inner dark.
[soft, slow, warm voice] No image is also a complete experience. Rest with the window closed.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel breath and body while the eyes recover.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Open the eyes and find the flame again, one bright coordinate in a wide cabin.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Let attention stay near the centre without hardening the brow.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice that the flame changes constantly while remaining easy to recognise.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Rest with this small sun for several natural breaths.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Close the eyes once more and allow the outer flame to become inner memory.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Let the image travel beyond the window and disappear into a larger darkness.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the whole face, whole body, and ordinary room returning.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Open your eyes slowly. Navigation is complete; take your time moving on.
